description: This Java source file defines the UtilCacheEvents class, which contains static methods for handling web events related to cache operations such as removing, clearing, updating caches, and handling multiple cache selections. It interacts with UtilCache, Security, and HTTP request/response objects to perform cache management tasks within the web application.

classes.name: UtilCacheEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling cache-related web events such as remove, clear, update, and batch cache operations.

methods.name: removeElementEvent
methods.description: Removes a specific element from a named cache based on request parameters, with permission checks.

methods.name: clearEvent
methods.description: Clears a specified cache if the user has permission.

methods.name: clearAllEvent
methods.description: Clears all caches if the user has permission.

methods.name: clearSelectedCachesEvent
methods.description: Clears multiple selected caches based on form input, with permission checks.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates cache settings such as max in memory, expire time, and soft reference usage, with permission checks.
